title: Predicting What Answer Engines Cite: Open Decision Models, Rerankers and a Distilled 4B Student on Ten Engines under Controlled Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.38090v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative engine optimization needs a scorer that ranks candidate pages by the share of an answer they will receive as citations. We measure pretrained rerankers, a hosted typed decision model (Jev), eight open decision models and distilled students on GEO-Bench queries answered by ten engines that receive the same candidate sources in their prompt. Where several engines answer the same query, they agree with one another at a within-group Spearman correlation of 0.704. Jev and two open 27B decision models, used without training, are the strongest scorers at 0.575 to 0.578. A Qwen3-Reranker-4B fine-tuned with low-rank adapters on teacher labels for other GEO-Bench queries, released as GEO Citation Ranker 4B, reaches 0.542 to 0.549 across three seeds, and its differences with the 27B models and with Jev are not distinguishable from zero on 229 queries. translated_title: 预测答案引擎会引用什么：受控检索条件下十个引擎上的开放决策模型、重排序器与蒸馏4B学生模型
translated_abstract: 生成式引擎优化（GEO）需要一个评分器，能够根据候选页面在答案中将获得的引用份额对其进行排序。我们在GEO-Bench查询上评估了预训练重排序器、一个托管型类型化决策模型、八个开放决策模型以及蒸馏学生模型，这些查询由十个引擎回答，所有引擎在其提示中接收相同的候选来源。当多个引擎回答同一查询时，它们彼此之间的组内Spearman相关性为0.704，表现出高度一致。未经训练直接使用的Jev和两个开放的27B决策模型是最强的评分器，得分介于0.575至0.578之间。一个基于针对其他GEO-Bench查询的教师标签、用低秩适配器微调的Qwen3-Reranker-4B（以GEO Citation Ranker 4B的名称发布），在三个随机种子上的得分达到0.542至0.549，并且它与27B模型以及Jev之间的差异在229个查询上与零无法区分。当Jev评分时，学生模型与Jev之间剩余的大部分差距消失……
tldr: 本研究评估了多种决策模型与重排序器预测答案引擎引用行为的能力，并证明经蒸馏微调的4B小模型（GEO Citation Ranker 4B）在性能上可与未经训练的27B决策模型相媲美。
en_tdlr: This study evaluates decision models and rerankers for predicting what answer engines cite, showing that a distilled 4B model (GEO Citation Ranker 4B) matches the performance of untrained 27B decision models.
